title.en: Linked plot and 3D selection through stable entity IDs

summary: Make a plot mark and a spatial object select the same semantic entity despite sorting, filtering or mesh replacement.
objective: Let a plot brush highlight matching 3D entities and let spatial selection identify their plotted observations after sorting and filtering.
intent_signals: Let a plot brush highlight matching 3D entities and let spatial selection identify their plotted observations after sorting and filtering.
example_prompts: Let a plot brush highlight matching 3D entities and let spatial selection identify their plotted observations after sorting and filtering.

principles: Use semantic entity identity as the shared selection authority; a plot index and a mesh index are temporary presentation addresses.
Define whether selection addresses an entity, one time sample, or an aggregate. An aggregated mark must disclose its members rather than inventing a one-to-one link.
implementation: Store selected entity IDs separately from hover, brush extent and visibility. Map plot data and hit meshes to those IDs; use a composite entity/time key when selecting observations rather than whole entities.
If using D3, bind marks with a key derived from the stable ID. Validate key uniqueness within the join; keyed DOM joins alone do not synchronize a Three.js scene.

Route both views through one selection reducer. Programmatic redraws consume selection without re-emitting user actions. Define replace/add/toggle semantics and distinguish a selected hidden entity from a deleted entity.

Show a visible selected-count/list control and a clear action. Preserve scientific color encodings by using outlines, badges or separate emphasis; retain filtering independently when clearing selection.
observable_checks: Select entity B, reverse plot order and replace its render mesh: B stays selected. A missing or duplicated ID is surfaced rather than selecting its new array neighbor.
Brush an aggregate of three entities, hide one via filtering, and inspect the selected count; visible and hidden membership follow the declared policy.
Clear selection from either view and confirm both views and metadata clear once while plot filter and model time remain unchanged.

known_limits: Identity must come from data ownership or a documented import mapping. This pattern does not establish that unrelated datasets describe the same entities.
Draft authored guidance; no renderer, interaction artifact or scientific result was executed for this record.
creative_affordances: Choose layout and visual emphasis to support the stated inspection task; these are design proposals rather than proven usability improvements.

claims.statement: D3 selection.data uses positional matching by default; a key function instead matches data and elements by string key, with duplicate keys assigned to enter or exit selections.
claims.scope: D3 DOM binding semantics only; cross-view state ownership is authored guidance.

source_refs.locator: selection.data(data, key): default join-by-index, string key matching and duplicate keys
